title: eliokarmos constrictus

It is native to Madagascar and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its numerous health benefits. The eliokarmos constrictus is said to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions including fever, pain, and respiratory issues.
